Steyvers, Lee & Wagenmakers (2009) 4-arm bandit — local TEH/PICS copy

Paper:
  Steyvers, M., Lee, M. D., & Wagenmakers, E.-J. (2009). A Bayesian analysis of
  human decision-making on bandit problems. Journal of Mathematical Psychology,
  53, 168–179. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmp.2008.11.002

Source:
  mdlee/behavioralDataRepository
  datasets/sequential-choice/steyvers-lee-wagenmakers-2009-bandit/
  (Lee coauthor; no independent public raw archive located at audit time)

Coding:
  Raw CSV choice ∈ {1,2,3,4}
  Internal TEH action ∈ {0,1,2,3} with action = choice - 1

Leakage:
  gameRewardRates.csv / rewardRateChosen are NOT exposed to choose().
  They may remain on disk as analysis metadata only.
